blockers: No candidate training corpus has PASS status in the dataset registry.
The Vietnamese travel-domain locked test has not been collected or annotated.
No eligible immutable row inventory exists, so assigning rows or publishing a split hash would be fabricated.
prohibited_inputs: travelgo_ai_m0_test rows for any performance or domain-quality claim
synthetic or machine-translated rows in any locked test
HuGo database dumps or unapproved exports
eligibility_gate_before_split: Dataset registry decision is PASS for the intended M2-B use.
Owner, official source, upstream lineage, license/user agreement and allowed purpose are documented.
Every raw file is pinned and SHA-256 verified.
Only explicit labels accepted by the label map remain.
At least 3,000 eligible Vietnamese travel/service rows remain after deduplication, matching the existing project data-quality gate.
PII scan/cleaning report and manual high-risk review pass without logging matched PII.
Travel-domain locked test rights, annotation guideline and adjudication record pass.

operation_order: Decode strict UTF-8 and reject undecodable rows.
Normalize Unicode to NFC; remove BOM/zero-width formatting controls; normalize line endings and repeated whitespace.
Reject null, empty, whitespace-only, invalid-label and structurally invalid records.
Detect email, Vietnamese/international phone, URL, order identifiers and account identifiers with versioned patterns.
Replace allowed incidental matches with typed tokens such as <EMAIL>, <PHONE>, <URL>, <ORDER_ID>, <ACCOUNT_ID>; quarantine high-risk or ambiguous identity-bearing rows for manual review.
Do not print raw matches in logs; report aggregate counts and rejection reasons only.
Preserve Vietnamese diacritics, negation, emoji, punctuation and intensity markers used by sentiment.
Compute exact and near-duplicate groups before any split assignment.

duplicate_and_leakage_specification.exact_duplicate_key: SHA-256 of NFC + lowercase + collapsed-whitespace text, computed locally and never used as a public reversible identifier
duplicate_and_leakage_specification.near_duplicate_method: character 5-gram MinHash candidate retrieval followed by exact Jaccard verification
duplicate_and_leakage_specification.grouping_rule: Union connected rows that are exact/near duplicates or share reviewer_id/entity_id when that metadata exists; one connected component must stay in exactly one split.
duplicate_and_leakage_specification.source_leakage_rule: Track source_family and upstream lineage before splitting; copies/derivatives of one corpus are one source family. Reserve a source/domain holdout when multiple independent sources exist and report it separately.
duplicate_and_leakage_specification.reviewer_leakage_rule: Group by privacy-safe reviewer key when available; otherwise record reviewer leakage as unmeasurable.
duplicate_and_leakage_specification.entity_leakage_rule: Group by entity/place/business when available; otherwise record entity leakage as unmeasurable.
post_split_assertions: zero near-duplicate-group overlap at the frozen threshold

split_specification.algorithm: deterministic grouped stratification after all cleaning and leakage grouping
split_specification.validation_usage: Select preprocessing, word/character feature settings, regularization, class_weight and decision policy only.
split_specification.test_usage: One locked final evaluation after the full pipeline and hyperparameters are frozen; never tune, relabel or select a model from test results.
lock_artifacts: ordered pseudonymous row IDs per split

travel_domain_locked_test_specification.collection_policy: Use original commissioned text or other clearly licensed text only; no Google Maps, test DB, synthetic generation or machine translation.
travel_domain_locked_test_specification.annotation_policy: At least two independent competent Vietnamese annotators per row; hide ratings/source labels/model predictions; adjudicate disagreement under a frozen guideline.
travel_domain_locked_test_specification.agreement_reporting: Report raw agreement and Krippendorff alpha or an appropriate chance-corrected statistic overall and by domain/class; predeclare the acceptance threshold before annotation.
travel_domain_locked_test_specification.leakage_policy: Authors/reviewers, entities and duplicate clusters must be disjoint from training/validation and the ordinary test when metadata permits.
travel_domain_locked_test_specification.usage: Domain evaluation only; never tune on it. If minimum support or rights/PII gates fail, domain quality remains BLOCKED.

secondary_metrics: batch and single-item latency on declared CPU
m2b_notebook_specification.tuning_policy: Validation only; test and travel-domain locked test remain sealed.
m2b_notebook_specification.phobert_gate: Do not train PhoBERT until a PASS dataset and locked split are committed and the TF-IDF baseline has completed on that exact split.
